statements.t: Today, with greater clarity on our full-year outlook as we approach year-end, we are providing an updated view of our 2026 financial outlook within our existing guidance ranges.
We believe the underlying characteristics of the business support a durable profile over the longer term, with 2028 FCFBG expected to be in line with 2027.
Management believes that XPLR's liquidity position and cash flows from operations will be adequate to finance O&M expenses, maintenance capital expenditures and liquidity commitments.
